anya: Quick bring-up notes for kraken-14b (hf/kraken-14b) — short econ + quality sketch, looking for routing/quant recs.
anya: TL;DR numbers from our 2k-sample eval (summarization & instr-follow): fp16 median latency 120ms (p95 220ms), int8 median 140ms (p95 290ms), int4 median 170ms (p95 480ms). Cost per 1M tokens (est): fp16 $9.2, int8 $3.5, int4 $1.9.
devin: Can you show the per-1M calc quick so I can plug into pricing model?
anya: Sure, rough calc included below (GPU amort + infra):
ravi: ```
# unit econ rough
fp16: (gpu_hour_cost 2.4 * tokens_per_hour 260k) -> $9.2 / 1M tokens
int8: same gpu * throughput uplift ~2.6x -> $3.5 / 1M
int4: uplift ~4.8x -> $1.9 / 1M
```
mike: Quality notes from eval: int8 is pretty close for short responses and retrieval-augmented answers. int4 shows higher hallucination, entity-name swaps, and repetition for multi-turn. Not safe for long-form by default.
sarah: On the instr-follow suite we saw an avg ROUGE-1 drop: int8 ~0.6 absolute, int4 ~2.4 absolute. Named-entity F1 drop: int8 ~0.9, int4 ~4.1. Example failures at int4: truncated legal clauses, swapped company names in taxonomy answers.
devin: My recommendation: default route -> int8 (saves ~62% vs fp16) for general workloads. Expose int4 as an opt-in low-cost tier but gate by prompt/route: only for short, non-sensitive prompts (e.g., search-snippets, cheap-summarize), and with sampling fallback to int8/fp16 on quality signals.
mike: Agree. Add prompt classifiers: if tokens_out > 128 OR tag in ["legal","finance","sensitive"] -> block int4. Also use quality-monitoring sample checks, rollback if entity-F1 drop >2.0.
anya: Proposed rollout plan: 1) push canary int8 -> 100k tokens/day across mixed traffic; 2) run 7d A/B with our eval harness capturing ROUGE, ent-F1, latency tail; 3) open experiment exposing int4 to internal beta for short prompts only. I'll open the infra PR with routing policy + metrics. :thumbsup:
ravi: Small note: int4 memory behavior requires new quant profile (per-channel symmetric) — infra change to allocator flags needed before scale.
sarah: Also recommend adding a targeted eval set for hallucination (named-entities, dates) so we can alarm on semantic drift, not just ROUGE.
devin: Acceptance gates proposal: ROUGE-1 drop <= 1.5 absolute vs fp16, named-entity F1 drop <= 2.0 absolute, p95 latency <= 2x of fp16. If any fail -> rollback.
anya: Action items: I'll file tickets for (a) routing policy + PR, (b) allocator/quant-profile infra change, (c) gated canary deployment + eval plan. Expect PRs by EOD tomorrow.

anya: thanks — will sync after the first 24h of canary to decide int4 beta next steps.
